methodologyNotes: Covers powered adjustable bed bases (motorized foundations that articulate the head and/or foot of the mattress) sold at a published US MSRP as a standalone base, in Queen size unless a brand ships only Split King. Excludes static platform/foundation frames, manual crank hospital beds, and mattress-plus-base bundles priced only as a set. Price is typical US MSRP for the Queen (or per-side Split King where Queen is unavailable), USD. weightCapacityLbs is the manufacturer's rated evenly-distributed capacity in pounds for one deck (per-side for split models). headArticulationDeg is the maximum head-section incline in degrees measured from flat (0). footArticulationDeg is the maximum foot/leg-section incline in degrees from flat. massageType is an enum: 'none', 'head-only', 'dual-zone', or 'full-body-wave'. zeroGravityPreset is a boolean for a one-touch zero-gravity position. antiSnorePreset is a boolean for a one-touch anti-snore/head-raise position. wallHugging is a boolean for a wall-hugging/zero-clearance design that keeps the sleeper near the nightstand as the head rises. memoryPresets is the count of user-programmable memory positions (0 if none). underBedLighting is a boolean for built-in under-bed lighting. usbPorts is the total number of USB charging ports on the base (any type). appControl is a boolean for smartphone app control over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi (a wireless RF remote alone does not count). warrantyYears is the length in years of the longest full (non-prorated) warranty term on the base mechanism; null if the manufacturer publishes only a prorated term.
